csv_project_name: Architectural Engineering Services for Nancy Lane Park
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Atoka requests statements of qualifications from engineering and architectural design firms for the development of Nancy Lane Park. This project is funded in part through a grant from the Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation (TDEC), Office of Outdoor Recreation (OOR). The selected firm will provide comprehensive architectural and engineering services for the design and construction support of a concession stand, maintenance shop facilities, and paving improvements within Nancy Lane Park. These services will include the development of complete construction documents necessary to successfully complete the project.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering
